summary: Staggered cohort stickiness loss during weighted split rollout causing silent model fallback
description:
Issue summary:
During a weighted, staggered split rollout for rw-open-2b-v1 -> rw-open-2b-v1-quant, ~12% of tenant traffic observed silent downgrade to the previous model variant despite a tenant-level pin expected to retain cohort stickiness. Impact: quality regressions and unexpected score variance in returned completions and embeddings for the customer VoiceCraft AI.

Impact:
- Affected customer sessions intermittently received responses from the old variant, causing downstream scoring/reranking to fail thresholds.
- Customer reported elevated error rates in their internal QA and a drop in semantic similarity metrics.

Environment:
- Production, us-east cluster serving the dedicated pool for VoiceCraft AI.
- Rollout executed via weighted split (10% -> 30% -> 60%) over 90 minutes.

Steps to reproduce (high level):
1) Configure a weighted split rollout for a pinned route with cohort cookie enabled.
2) Promote canary to 30% weight and allow edge-proxy to reconcile.
3) Trigger concurrent session resumption and long-poll client reconnects from the same tenant.
4) Observe that a subset of requests from previously-pinned cohorts route to the older variant.

Logs and evidence pointers: see logs field.
steps_to_reproduce: Create a tenant pinned to rw-open-2b-v1 and start a mix of short-lived and long-lived sessions.
Start a weighted split rollout pushing rw-open-2b-v1-quant to 30% for 30 minutes.
Simulate client reconnects and long-poll reconnects for the pinned tenant during the weight transition.
Monitor routing-logs and edge cookie reconciliation for the tenant; compare model id in request headers versus session pin metadata.

comments: Support (Aisha): Customer reported that semantic-similarity scores dropped by ~18% after the second weight increase. They saw mismatch between expected pinned model and actual responses.
SRE (Benji Morales): Observed edge-proxy healthprobe spikes at times of weight change; cookie TTLs and edge cache TTLs looked misaligned. Collecting routing traces now. (slack: #support)
Customer (VoiceCraft AI - Elena Ramos): Providing sample request_ids and QA diffs. Customer requests priority fix and mitigation while rollout is ongoing.

Eng (Clara Nguyen): Reproduced locally with a scaled rerun; hypothesis: pin commit ordering raced with fallback path when edge deferred commit on probe latency. Opening PR to add commit-ack semantics. See PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/4123.
SRE (Daniel Ortega): Applied a temporary mitigation: suppressed fallback route selection for tenants with active pin state during weight promotion window. Monitoring impact.
Support (Aisha): Customer acknowledged mitigation; will monitor for 24 hours and confirm stability.
investigation_notes: Initial correlation: spike of edge healthprobe latency (200-600ms) coincident with weight transitions correlated to routing cache misses.
Observed a TTL mismatch: cohort cookie TTL (600s) vs. edge-route-commit TTL (30s) allowed short windows where edge rejected pin commit and served fallback route.

Race condition found in pin reconciliation flow: commit message to edge could be deferred when healthprobe latency > threshold; deferred commit did not re-enqueue prior to routing decision, allowing fallback selection path to be taken.
Reproduction successful in staging by artificially delaying edge commit ack and generating concurrent reconnects from same tenant; reproduced ~12% silent fallbacks.
Related prior tickets: SUP-24681 (session ghosting) and SUP-71102 (edge probe timing), but root cause differs (ordering vs. cookie corruption).
resolution: Hotfix deployed: changed pin commit protocol to require edge commit-ack (best-effort synchronous commit within rollout window) and added a short grace period (5s) where fallback selection is suppressed for tenants with active pin-state. Also aligned TTLs: edge-route-commit TTL increased to 120s and cohort cookie TTL validated. Mitigation rolled to staging, smoke-tested with heavy reconnect patterns, then promoted to prod at 2026-02-22T03:15:00Z. Observed fallback rate reduced to <0.1% and customer metrics returned to baseline within 2 hours.
follow_up_actions: (Action) Add rollout validation gate that compares pin commit acks across edge fleet before weight increase (owner: routing team, due: 2026-03-05).
(Action) Update rollout runbook to include 'suppress fallback during active pin promotions' as an optional safety toggle (owner: SRE, due: 2026-03-01).
(Action) Add automated test that simulates deferred commit ack and client reconnects during weighted rollouts (owner: QA, due: 2026-03-12).
(Action) Postmortem note and customer follow-up scheduled; CS to send RCA and timeline to VoiceCraft AI (owner: Aisha Patel, due: 2026-02-24).
